notes: Pricing Advisor 2.0 now prices with a withhold-first workflow and a 1.40 economic factor while preserving the sent 1.30/1.32 buy-rate policy. Both models receive the complete parsed banking and credit evidence set; the tree evaluates all 140 inputs, while each neural stage selects the 30 most predictive inputs to prevent overfitting. This release also corrects validation so each model is measured through the same hold-to-term path used by the live advisor, and retains expanded factor impacts, position details, confidence reasons, and immediate personal calibration.
